info.title: Lotse Console API
info.description: HTTP gateway and UI backend of lotse-console.

get.summary: Role bindings: all for a cluster admin, one's own for everyone else.

post.summary: Pins a partition's leader to one of its replicas, or unpins it.

get.summary:
Chart history from the console's in-memory buffer (at most 180 points):
the sum over the streams and queues the caller may see; the commit
latency only for cluster admins and cluster viewers.
Nodes, rolling upgrade and operator events.

post.summary:
Settles a queue's ready messages: what consumers hold stays theirs.
Destructive: the body names the queue again.

Moves the ready messages of a dead-letter queue back to the queues they
came from, each once.

Ends the sessions of a user or an IdP group that began before now.
Destructive: the body names the subject again.

get.summary: Reads records without joining a consumer group.

post.summary: Stops the rolling upgrade after the node it is on.

get.summary: SCRAM users. The broker lets only cluster admins list them.

post.summary: Creates a user with a credential the browser derived.

delete.summary: Deletes a user. Destructive: the body names the user again.

put.summary: Sets a new password for a user, as a derived credential.

detail.description: What happened and what to do.

node.description: Node the alert is about, if any.

incoming.description: Partitions on their way to it.

Assignment.description: Who owns which partition in a group.

note.description: Explanation of a handover in progress.

BindingRow.description: A role binding with its tenant, prefix and where it comes from.

prefix.description: Name prefix the binding covers; empty means every name.

subject_kind.description: `user` or `group` (a group at the identity provider).

tenant.description: Tenant; empty for the two cluster-wide roles.

bindings.description:
Every binding the caller may see: all of them for a cluster admin,
the caller's own for everyone else.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may change bindings.

Chip.description: A status chip: colour plus word, never colour alone.

text.description: Word shown next to the colour.

demo.description: `true` when served by the built-in demo cluster.

id.description: Cluster ID from the console config.

queue_options.description:
Whether queues can have priorities, single active consumer, a TTL
and dead-letter queues.

tenants.description: Whether the cluster has tenants (quotas, role bindings).

name.description: Name: lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens.

tenant.description: Tenant; required where the cluster has tenants, absent elsewhere.

CreateUser.description: Request to create a user with a credential.

Credential.description:
A SCRAM credential derived in the browser (ADR 0089). There is no
password field: the console never sees one.

iterations.description: PBKDF2 iterations; the broker refuses fewer than its minimum.

DeleteUser.description: Request to delete a user. Destructive: names the user again.

DiskLimits.description: Disk thresholds, as fractions of free space.

hard_free.description: Writes are rejected below this free fraction.

soft_free.description: Producers are throttled below this free fraction.

Done.description: Result of a write, with the CLI command that does the same.

ErrorBody.description: Error body for every failed request.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do.

Group.description: A consumer group reading a stream.

lag_trend.description: Lag samples over the last hour, oldest first.

HandoverEvent.description: An entry in the single-active-consumer handover log.

HealthItem.description: One line of the health list.

oneOf.description: Status chip, if the item has one.

Me.description: The signed-in user, as the cluster sees them.

MoveLeader.description:
Request to pin a partition's leader to one of its replicas, or to unpin
it (ADR 0065).

node.description:
The node to lead it, as the console names nodes; `None` unpins it so
that leaders spread by themselves again.

disk_free_bytes.description: Free bytes on the log volume.

produce_bytes_per_sec.description: Client produce traffic into this node, bytes/s.

replicas.description: Raft groups with a replica on this node.

oneOf.description: Disk thresholds, if the cluster has them.
Disk thresholds for the bars, if the cluster has them.

metadata_leader.description: Node that leads the metadata group.

last_stable.description: Below the first open transaction; `read_committed` stops here.

Point.description: One point of a time series.

PriorityLevel.description: A queue priority level (ADR 0078: levels share the queue's one log).

leader.description: Leader of the queue the level belongs to.

level.description: Level number; higher is delivered first.

oldest_ms.description: Age of the oldest ready message, ms.

PurgeQueue.description:
Request to purge a queue's ready messages (ADR 0064). Destructive, so
the queue's name must be typed again.

confirm.description: The queue's name, typed by the user.

principal.description: Principal; `null` while the cluster has no authentication.

binding.description: Exchange and binding key, if bound.

in_open_txns.description: Acks waiting for their transaction to commit.

oneOf.description: Why the queue needs attention, if it does.

value.description: Value as UTF-8, if it is.

RecordView.description: A record read through the browser.

value.description: Value as UTF-8, if it is.

ReplicaState.description: Role of a replica in a Raft group.

RevokeSessions.description:
Request to revoke the sessions of a user or an IdP group (ADR 0070).
Destructive: names the subject again.

group.description: `true` for a group at the identity provider.

auth.description:
How the subject is recognised: `user` or `group` (a group at the
identity provider); the demo says `mTLS` or `OIDC`.

oneOf.description: Assignment of the group the UI highlights.

oldest_record_age_ms.description: Age of the oldest record, ms.

oneOf.description: What the stream keeps; `None` when the cluster did not say.

StreamRetention.description: How long and how much a stream keeps.

bytes.description: Each partition keeps about this many bytes; `None`: no limit by size.

ms.description: Records older than this many milliseconds go; `None`: no limit by age.

quota_bytes.description: Storage quota, bytes; `None` where the cluster has no quotas.

commit_p99_ms.description:
p99 time until a produce is acknowledged by a quorum, ms; `null`
without produces to measure.

Tone.description: Health of something, as the UI colours it.

TxnState.description: Transaction state of a record as a reader sees it.

Upgrade.description: A rolling upgrade run by the operator.

groups_catching_up.description: Raft groups still catching up on the current node.

paused_after_current.description: `true` once the operator stops after the current node.

steps.description: Steps, one per node in upgrade order.

UpgradePhase.description: A phase of upgrading one node.

UpgradeStep.description: One node's progress through a rolling upgrade.

phases.description: Phases in order, with their state.

UserRow.description:
A SCRAM user. Key material never leaves the cluster, so a row says only
how the user is stored.

iterations.description: PBKDF2 iterations of the stored credential.

name.description: User name, the principal in role bindings.

roles.description: Bindings that name this user, as `role (tenant)` texts.
